mapper.insert:
insert into t_union_task_attr( union_id, instance_id, device_mete_id, device_custom_id, if_robot, if_video, if_inferad )values
( #{TUnionTaskAttr.unionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.deviceMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.deviceCustomId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.ifRobot, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.ifVideo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TUnionTaskAttr.ifInferad, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.union_id, a.mete_id, j.dict_note as mete_kind_name, b.rule_id, b.rule_name, b.plan_id, b.camera_id, b.preset_id, d.plan_name, a.create_time, b.rule_content, h.device_name, k.mete_value FROM t_union_task a LEFT JOIN t_cfg_union_rule b on a.rule_id = b.rule_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_plan d on d.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cfg_data_current k on k.mete_id = a.mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business j on j.dict_code = k.mete_kind and j.col_name = "mete_kind" LEFT JOIN t_cfg_device h on h.device_id = k.device_id where 1 = 1 and a.union_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} limit 1

SELECT a.task_id, a.instance_id, a.device_id, b.device_name, d.real_code, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN k.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN m.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN n.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',k.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',m.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name FROM t_cruise_task_attr a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device_attr d on d.device_id = a.device_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance l on l.instance_id = a.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k ON l.cruise_id = k.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection m ON m.inspection_id = l.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete n ON n.device_mete_id = l.device_mete_id WHERE 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT a.task_name FROM t_cruise_task a where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT a.dict_note FROM t_dict_business a WHERE 1 = 1 and a.dict_code = #{cruiseResult, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.col_name = "cruise_result"
